name: TVDB Community Fix
description: Drop-in replacement for the official TheTVDB plugin that adds a workaround for the upstream TVDB v4 API bug where /series/{id}/episodes/altdvd and /alttwo return an empty episodes array. When the primary endpoint comes back empty, the plugin falls back to walking the extended series record and aggregating episodes per matching season. References: jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-tvdb#226, thetvdb/v4-api#340.
overview: TheTVDB metadata with the altdvd / alttwo workaround applied

versions.changelog: Workaround for upstream TVDB API bug affecting altdvd / alttwo season types (#226, thetvdb/v4-api#340).
